gram periodically checks the clipboard at the specified interval
When it finds new content, it:

For text: Records it directly in the CSV file
For images: Saves the image file to the image directory and records its path in the CSV

The CSV file includes:

Timestamp
Content type (text, image, HTML, etc.)
Content (text or description)
Image path (if applicable)



Image Handling

Images are saved as PNG files
A simple hash function prevents duplicate images
Filenames include timestamps for easy tracking

Data Storage

By default, data is stored in the user's local data directory
Images go to a separate subdirectory
All paths can be customized via command-line options

Customization Ideas

Add a web interface to view your clipboard history
Create a hotkey to open recent clipboard items
Set up rotation/cleanup of old entries
Add encryption for sensitive clipboard data
